item.tib: rig 'dzin sku gsum dgongs pa 'dus pa'i rgyud las bla ma'i drag sgrub ma rung tshar gcod kyi las byang zla dkar shel gyi me long
item.coloph: bdag 'dra o rgyan bde chen gling pa'am mi 'gyur tshe dbang gsang sngags grags pa rtsal gyis kong yul gyer re'i dbus phyogs yongs rdzong dpal gyi phug nas sa rta lo phag zla'i tshes bco lnga'i gdugs gang la DAk+ki karma dpal sgron gyis brda' mdzad de/ kho bo rang gis yang li zhu dang chos gos byas shing spos dang sgra dbyangs rol mo'i tshogs kyis ser 'phreng bcas te spyan drangs pa'o/ slar lha brag mched gsum gyi ru lag g.yu mtsho drag po mdangs ldan gyi gling du bod yig tu spel ba dge legs 'phel rgyas shog/

item.tib: rig 'dzin sku gsum dgongs pa 'dus pa'i rgyud las bla ma drag sgrub kyi las byang
item.coloph: bdag 'dra bde chen gling pa'am mi 'gyur tshe dbang gsang sngags grags pa rtsal gyis kong yul gyer ri'i dbus phyogs yongs rdzong dpal gyi phug nas sa rta lo phag zla'i tshes bco lnga'i gdug (gdugs)gung la Dak+ki dpal sgron pad ma gyis bad+ha (brda) thabs mdzad de kho bo rang gi yang li zhu dang chos gos byas shing spos dang sgra dbyangs rol mo'i tshogs kyis ser phreng bcas te spyan drangs pa'o slar lha brag mched gsum gyi ru lag g.yu mtsho drag po mdangs ldan gyi gling du bod yig tu spel ba dge legs 'phel rgyas shog
